titleAsPrinted: FUDA Extruded Polystyrene Board (XPS) Technical Data Sheet (TDS)
edition: English translation by Sahihi, 2026-11-26, of the Chinese sheet
description: made from polystyrene resin as the main raw material, with blowing agent, flame retardant and other additives, formed by an extrusion process.
advantages: closed-cell structure, high strength, low thermal conductivity, moisture resistant, corrosion resistant
Class B1 products contain flame retardant and self-extinguish when the flame is removed
the blowing agent contains no HCFC or CFC; the flame retardant contains no HBCD
notFor: Avoid long-term exposure to ultraviolet light (a protective layer is required)
it is not in direct contact with any solvent-based product
it is not in direct contact with products containing added plasticisers
the loads carried are within the product's strength range
keep away from sources of fire, protect from moisture, avoid heavy loads

technicalData.label: Warranty period
technicalData.value: 10 years under normal conditions of use

packaging: Thickness: 20 mm to 100 mm (can be customised)
storage: keep away from sources of fire, protect from moisture, avoid heavy loads
